verdict.rationale: PayPal's hosted Checkout/button flow (paypal-docs-2, paypal-docs-19) and secure PayPal payment pages for invoicing (paypal-docs-22) mean card/funding data is handled on PayPal's side rather than the merchant's server, supporting reduced PCI scope, but the evidence pack never explicitly states PCI DSS SAQ eligibility, tokenization mechanics, or scope-reduction claims. missing for 10: explicit PCI DSS SAQ-A/scope-reduction documentation, tokenization architecture details, and any card-data-never-touches-servers guarantee language.
